text:
jess: Hey infra team — we're onboarding a new AWS account for the EU inference fleet (account: rw-infer-eu-prod). Need help with VPC/VNet setup and quota increases before we cutover next week. High level: 3-AZ VPC, private subnets for GPUs, public subnets for jumpboxes, need 6 p4de.24xlarge on day 1 (scale target 20), plus NAT gateway redundancy. Also want a VPC peering to the centralized-logging VPC and PrivateLink endpoints for ECR/S3/SSM.

raj: Quick q — GPU instances: are those dedicated on-demand or spot? Also do we need Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) enabled?

jess: On-demand reserved-style capacity for predictability. No EFA for now — standard ENI only. We'll need ENI quota bump if we plan multiple GPUs per host. Initial ask: p4de.24xlarge x6 (region eu-west-1), vCPU/ENI limits probably will need increase.

samir: Cost heads-up: p4de.24x is ~? (I'll pull numbers) but NAT+EIP counts will add fixed monthly cost if we have one NAT per AZ. Do we require 3 NAT gateways or can we use NAT Instances / shared NAT?

jess: Prefer managed NAT gateways for simplicity and throughput. We expect ~3 NAT gateways (one per AZ) and 6 EIPs (for autoscaling/HA, allow some spare). Default AWS account limits are low (NAT gateways/EIPs default=5), so request to 10.

marie: Routing and peering note — logging VPC CIDR is 10.2.0.0/16, our new VPC will be 10.10.0.0/16. We need peering and update of route tables in both VPCs to route 10.2.0.0/16 <-> 10.10.0.0/16. Also need to ensure no overlapping with existing Transit Gateway attachments.

jess: Also need PrivateLink endpoints for ECR (com.amazonaws.eu-west-1.ecr.api), S3 gateway endpoints, and SSM. S3 can be gateway endpoint but ECR/SSM will be interface endpoints — those consume ENI quotas and security group rules. Requesting interface endpoint quota increases to allow 15 endpoints.

cloud-support-bot: Hi team — here's a suggested AWS support case body you can paste into the console for quota increases. Replace placeholders: 

```
Subject: Quota increase and service limits for account rw-infer-eu-prod (support access granted)
Region: eu-west-1

Requests:
1) EC2 Instances (On-Demand) - p4de.24xlarge: Increase desired limit to 20 (current 0)
2) Elastic IPs: Increase desired limit to 10 (current 5)
3) NAT Gateways: Increase desired limit to 10 (current 5)
4) Elastic Network Interfaces (ENI) per region: Increase by 200
5) Interface VPC Endpoints (com.amazonaws.*): Increase total endpoints to 30
6) EBS optimized instances / throughput quotas as needed for p4 family (specify if required)

Justification: Production inference fleet reserved capacity for Redwood Inference. Predictable low-latency serving requires dedicated p4 instances and multiple interface endpoints for ECR/SSM. We will operate across 3 AZs and require NAT/EIP counts for HA.
```

cloud-support-bot: Also, for the VPC peering request include the peering connection id from the centralized-logging account and the CIDR validation screenshots. If you want, I can open the initial AWS support case with these details once you confirm numbers.

raj: Thanks. Can you also include a note to increase "Security groups per ENI" and "Ingress rules per security group"? Interface endpoints for ECR/SSM will add many SG entries.

jess: Good call. Add: Security groups per ENI to 10, Ingress rules per SG to 100.

marie: Terraform snippet for the VPC peering route (example) — drop into the infra repo: 
```
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "logging_peer" {
  peer_vpc_id = "vpc-logging-1234"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.infer_vpc.id
  peer_region = "eu-west-1"
  auto_accept = false
}

resource "aws_route" "to_logging" {
  route_table_id         = aws_route_table.private_rt.id
  destination_cidr_block = "10.2.0.0/16"
  vpc_peering_connection_id = aws_vpc_peering_connection.logging_peer.id
}
```

samir: If support approves EIP/NAT increases, recommend we use a small automated teardown policy for unused EIPs to avoid long term cost. Also consider using a single NAT gateway in one AZ with cross-zone traffic if budget becomes an issue.

jess: Ack — we'll keep HA (3 NATs) for now for production. Samir, please add a cost projection to the PR.

cloud-support-bot: To proceed I need confirmation of the exact numbers. Reply with a single line: "APPROVE: p4de=20, ENI=200, EIP=10, NAT=10, Endpoints=30, SG/ENI=10, Rules/SG=100" and I will open the case and attach Terraform plan output.

jess: APPROVE: p4de=20, ENI=200, EIP=10, NAT=10, Endpoints=30, SG/ENI=10, Rules/SG=100 :thumbsup:

raj: I'll follow up with the route table PR and peering request details.

samir: I'll draft the cost estimate and tag the PR with budget owner.

marie: I'll add the endpoint SG templates and make sure we whitelist the logging VPC on the peering.

cloud-support-bot: Support case submitted (case id: 1234567890). I'll post updates here when AWS responds. :white_check_mark:

jess: Thanks all — moving to infra backlog and tagging owners.
